title: त्रिषष्टितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 63 · Drona forms the Shakata and Padma arrays

summary.en: At dawn Drona draws up the army in a cart-shaped array with a lotus array and a needle-point array inside it. Jayadratha is placed deep in the needle array, behind the great chariot-warriors.
summary.kn: ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ದ್ರೋಣ ಸೈನ್ಯವನ್ನು ಶಕಟವ್ಯೂಹದಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿ ಅದರೊಳಗೆ ಪದ್ಮವ್ಯೂಹ, ಸೂಚೀವ್ಯೂಹ ರಚಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಜಯದ್ರಥನನ್ನು ಮಹಾರಥರ ಹಿಂದೆ ಸೂಚೀವ್ಯೂಹದ ಆಳದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: भोर में द्रोण सेना को शकट-व्यूह में सजाते हैं, उसके भीतर पद्म-व्यूह और सूची-व्यूह हैं। जयद्रथ को महारथियों के पीछे सूची-व्यूह के गहरे भाग में रखा जाता है।
summary.te: ఉదయం ద్రోణుడు సేనను శకట వ్యూహంలో అమరుస్తాడు, దాని లోపల పద్మ వ్యూహం, సూచీ వ్యూహం ఉంటాయి. జయద్రథుని మహారథుల వెనుక సూచీ వ్యూహం లోతున ఉంచుతారు.
summary.ta: விடியலில் த்ரோணர் படையைச் சகட வியூகத்தில் அணிவகுக்கிறார்; அதனுள் தாமரை வியூகமும் ஊசி வியூகமும் உள்ளன. ஜயத்ரதன் பெருந்தேர்வீரர் பின்னால் ஊசி வியூகத்தின் ஆழத்தில் நிறுத்தப்படுகிறான்.
summary.ml: പ്രഭാതത്തിൽ ദ്രോണർ വണ്ടിയുടെ ആകൃതിയിലുള്ള വ്യൂഹവും അതിനുള്ളിൽ താമരവ്യൂഹവും സൂചിമുനവ്യൂഹവും ഒരുക്കുന്നു. സൂചിവ്യൂഹത്തിന്റെ ആഴത്തിൽ, മഹാരഥന്മാർക്കു പിന്നിലായി ജയദ്രഥനെ നിർത്തുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.63; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
तस्यां निशायां व्युष्टायां द्रोणः शस्त्रभृतां वरः ।
स्वान्यनीकानि सर्वाणि प्राक्रामद्व्यूहितुं ततः ॥

meaning.en: When that night had passed, Drona, best of those who bear weapons, went forward to array all his forces.

verses.text:
शूराणां गर्जतां राजन्संक्रुद्धानाममर्षिणाम् ।
श्रूयन्ते स्म गिरश्चित्राः परस्परवधैषिणाम् ॥

meaning.en: O king, the varied voices of brave, angry, intolerant men roaring and seeking each other's death were heard.

verses.text:
विस्फार्य च धनूंष्याजौ ज्याः करैः परिमृज्य च ।
विनिःश्वसन्तः प्राक्रोशन्क्वेदानीं स धनंजयः ॥

meaning.en: Twanging their bows in the battlefield and wiping the strings with their hands, they cried out, sighing, "Where is Dhananjaya now?"

verses.text:
विकोशान्सुत्सरूनन्ये कृतधारान्समाहितान् ।
पीतानाकाशसंकाशानसीन्केचिच्च चिक्षिपुः ॥

meaning.en: Others threw swords, drawn from their sheaths, with good hilts, sharpened and well kept, yellow-gleaming like the sky.

verses.text:
चरन्तस्त्वसिमार्गांश्च धनुर्मार्गांश्च शिक्षया ।
संग्राममनसः शूरा दृश्यन्ते स्म सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: Thousands of heroes were seen with their minds on battle, practising sword-moves and bow-moves with skill.

verses.text:
सघण्टाश्चन्दनादिग्धाः स्वर्णवज्रविभूषिताः ।
समुत्क्षिप्य गदाश्चान्ये पर्यपृच्छन्त पाण्डवम् ॥

meaning.en: Others, raising maces with bells, anointed with sandalwood and adorned with gold and diamonds, asked after the Pandava.

verses.text:
अन्ये बलमदोन्मत्ताः परिघैर्बाहुशालिनः ।
चक्रुः संबाधमाकाशमुच्छ्रितेन्द्रध्वजोपमैः ॥

meaning.en: Others, mad with pride of strength and powerful in arm, filled the sky with clubs like raised Indra-banners.

verses.text:
नानाप्रहरणैश्चान्ये विचित्रस्रगलंकृताः ।
संग्राममनसः शूरास्तत्र तत्र व्यवस्थिताः ॥

meaning.en: Still others, adorned with many-coloured garlands and holding various weapons, stood here and there with their minds on battle.

verses.text:
क्वार्जुनः क्व च गोविन्दः क्व च मानी वृकोदरः ।
क्व च ते सुहृदस्तेषामाह्वयन्तो रणे तदा ॥

meaning.en: "Where is Arjuna, where is Govinda, where is proud Vrikodara, and where are their friends?" they called out in the fight.

verses.text:
ततः शङ्खमुपाध्माय त्वरयन्वाजिनः स्वयम् ।
इतस्ततस्तान्रचयन्द्रोणश्चरति वेगितः ॥

meaning.en: Then, blowing his conch and urging the horses himself, Drona hurried about, arranging them here and there.

verses.text:
तेष्वनीकेषु सर्वेषु स्थितेष्वाहवनन्दिषु ।
भारद्वाजो महाराज जयद्रथमथाब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: When all those divisions that delighted in battle had taken their places, O great king, Bharadvaja's son said to Jayadratha.

verses.text:
त्वं चैव सौमदत्तिश्च कर्णश्चैव महारथः ।
अश्वत्थामा च शल्यश्च वृषसेनः कृपस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: "You, Somadatta's son, the great chariot-warrior Karna, Ashvatthama, Shalya, Vrishasena and Kripa,"

verses.text:
शतं चाश्वसहस्राणां रथानामयुतानि षट् ।
द्विरदानां प्रभिन्नानां सहस्राणि चतुर्दश ॥

meaning.en: "with a hundred thousand horses, six myriads of chariots, fourteen thousand rutting elephants,"

verses.text:
पदातीनां सहस्राणि दंशितान्येकविंशतिः ।
गव्यूतिषु त्रिमात्रेषु मामनासाद्य तिष्ठत ॥

meaning.en: "and twenty-one thousand armoured foot-soldiers, take your stand three gavyutis away, without coming near me."

verses.text:
तत्रस्थं त्वां न संसोढुं शक्ता देवाः सवासवाः ।
किं पुनः पाण्डवाः सर्वे समाश्वसिहि सैन्धव ॥

meaning.en: "Even the gods with Indra could not withstand you standing there, let alone all the Pandavas. Be reassured, Saindhava."

verses.text:
एवमुक्तः समाश्वस्तः सिन्धुराजो जयद्रथः ।
संप्रायात्सह गान्धारैर्वृतस्तैश्च महारथैः ।
वर्मिभिः सादिभिर्यत्तैः प्रासपाणिभिरास्थितैः ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed and reassured, Jayadratha, the Sindhu king, set out with the Gandharas, surrounded by those great chariot-warriors, with armoured cavalry, alert, holding spears.

verses.text:
चामरापीडिनः सर्वे जाम्बूनदविभूषिताः ।
जयद्रथस्य राजेन्द्र हयाः साधुप्रवाहिनः ।
ते चैव सप्तसाहस्रा द्विसाहस्राश्च सैन्धवाः ॥

meaning.en: O king of kings, Jayadratha's horses, with fan-plumes and gold ornaments, were fine carriers, and there were seven thousand of them, and two thousand of the Saindhavas.

verses.text:
मत्तानामधिरूढानां हस्त्यारोहैर्विशारदैः ।
नागानां भीमरूपाणां वर्मिणां रौद्रकर्मिणाम् ॥

meaning.en: There were rutting elephants of fearsome form, armoured, of dreadful deeds, ridden by skilled mahouts.

verses.text:
अध्यर्धेन सहस्रेण पुत्रो दुर्मर्षणस्तव ।
अग्रतः सर्वसैन्यानां योत्स्यमानो व्यवस्थितः ॥

meaning.en: With one thousand five hundred of them, your son Durmarshana stood in front of the whole army, ready to fight.

verses.text:
ततो दुःशासनश्चैव विकर्णश्च तवात्मजौ ।
सिन्धुराजार्थसिद्ध्यर्थमग्रानीके व्यवस्थितौ ॥

meaning.en: Then your sons Duhshasana and Vikarna stood in the vanguard to accomplish the Sindhu king's aim.

verses.text:
दीर्घो द्वादशगव्यूतिः पश्चार्धे पञ्च विस्तृतः ।
व्यूहः स चक्रशकटो भारद्वाजेन निर्मितः ॥

meaning.en: The formation Bharadvaja's son made, the wheel-like cart, was twelve gavyutis long and five wide at its rear half.

verses.text:
नानानृपतिभिर्वीरैस्तत्र तत्र व्यवस्थितैः ।
रथाश्वगजपत्त्योघैर्द्रोणेन विहितः स्वयम् ॥

meaning.en: Drona himself arranged it with masses of chariots, horses, elephants and foot-soldiers, with heroic kings of many kinds standing here and there.

verses.text:
पश्चार्धे तस्य पद्मस्तु गर्भव्यूहः सुदुर्भिदः ।
सूची पद्मस्य मध्यस्थो गूढो व्यूहः पुनः कृतः ॥

meaning.en: At its rear half was a lotus, a womb-formation very hard to break, and within the lotus a needle-shaped formation was again made, hidden.

verses.text:
एवमेतं महाव्यूहं व्यूह्य द्रोणो व्यवस्थितः ।
सूचीमुखे महेष्वासः कृतवर्मा व्यवस्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Having arrayed that great formation, Drona took his stand, and the great archer Kritavarman stood at the tip of the needle.

verses.text:
अनन्तरं च काम्बोजो जलसंधश्च मारिष ।
दुर्योधनः सहामात्यस्तदनन्तरमेव च ॥

meaning.en: Next to him stood the Kamboja and Jalasandha, sir, and after them Duryodhana with his ministers.

verses.text:
ततः शतसहस्राणि योधानामनिवर्तिनाम् ।
व्यवस्थितानि सर्वाणि शकटे सूचिरक्षिणः ॥

meaning.en: Then a hundred thousand warriors who never retreat were all stationed in the cart to guard the needle.

verses.text:
तेषां च पृष्ठतो राज बलेन महता वृतः ।
जयद्रथस्ततो राजन्सूचिपाशे व्यवस्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Behind them, O king, surrounded by a great force, Jayadratha stood in the noose of the needle.

verses.text:
शकटस्य तु राजेन्द्र भारद्वाजो मुखे स्थितः ।
अनु तस्याभवद्भोजो जुगोपैनं ततः स्वयम् ॥

meaning.en: At the mouth of the cart, O king of kings, stood Bharadvaja's son, and behind him the Bhoja protected him.

verses.text:
श्वेतवर्माम्बरोष्णीषो व्यूढोरस्को महाभुजः ।
धनुर्विस्फारयन्द्रोणस्तस्थौ क्रुद्ध इवान्तकः ॥

meaning.en: Drona, in white armour, clothes and turban, broad-chested and long-armed, stood stretching his bow, like angry Death.

verses.text:
पताकिनं शोणहयं वेदीकृष्णाजिनध्वजम् ।
द्रोणस्य रथमालोक्य प्रहृष्टाः कुरवोऽभवन् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Drona's chariot, with its flag, red horses and banner of an altar and a black antelope skin, the Kurus rejoiced.

verses.text:
सिद्धचारणसंघानां विस्मयः सुमहानभूत् ।
द्रोणेन विहितं दृष्ट्वा व्यूहं क्षुब्धार्णवोपमम् ॥

meaning.en: Great was the wonder of the hosts of siddhas and charanas, seeing the formation Drona had set up, like a churning ocean.

verses.text:
सशैलसागरवनां नानाजनपदाकुलाम् ।
ग्रसेद्व्यूहः क्षितिं सर्वामिति भूतानि मेनिरे ॥

meaning.en: Beings thought, "That formation could swallow the whole earth with its mountains, seas and forests, and its many countries."

verses.text:
बहुरथमनुजाश्वपत्तिनागं
प्रतिभयनिस्वनमद्भुताभरूपम् ।
अहितहृदयभेदनं महद्वै
शकटमवेक्ष्य कृतं ननन्द राजा ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the great cart-formation made, with many chariots, men, horses, foot-soldiers and elephants, a fearful sound and a wondrous look, piercing the hearts of enemies, the king rejoiced.
